_comment: Project-specific hints for STAILOR. Place in se_config/<project>/project_hints.json

build_hints.description: Help the build system find headers and set correct flags

type_hints.description: Help the agent understand project-specific types and patterns

key_types.struct sk_buff: Network packet buffer — contains data pointer, len, head/tail offsets
key_types.struct sock: Network socket — contains protocol state, receive queue, send buffer
key_types.struct tcp_sock: TCP-specific socket state — extends struct sock with TCP fields
key_types.struct tcphdr: TCP header — 20 bytes minimum, contains flags, window, seq/ack numbers

allocation_patterns.sk_buff: Use alloc_skb(size, GFP_KERNEL); set skb->data, skb->len, skb->head
allocation_patterns.sock: Cannot allocate directly — use sk_alloc() or mock with malloc + memset
allocation_patterns.tcp_sock: Embedded in struct sock — cast via tcp_sk(sk)

analysis_hints.description: Domain knowledge for the LLM agent
entry_point_patterns: Functions called from softirq context: tcp_v4_rcv, tcp_rcv_established
common_vulnerability_patterns: Unchecked option/extension lengths in packet parsing
Integer overflow in sequence number arithmetic
Use-after-free when socket is released during callback
Race conditions between user and softirq context
symbolic_input_advice: Make sk_buff->len symbolic but constrained to reasonable range (0-65535)
TCP header fields (seq, ack_seq, window) should be symbolic
Keep socket state (tcp_sock fields) concrete — initialize to ESTABLISHED state
